status: AUTHOR ONLY. No compiler, target, solver, decoder, Git or SHA action; root must fully read before any build/run.
reuse: Small literal standalone JSphCpuSingle fixture using retained upl_free_seepage_cpu_r1.cpp CellTable/81-point geometry and upl_p2_feedback_harness_r1.cpp real Alloc/Reserve/InitPorosityObserver lifecycle. No included CPP, renamed main, copied filter, fake allocator capacity or physical integrator.
geometry: 9x9 dyadic points x,z=0..2 step.25, Cubic float h=1.2dp, actual two-group5x1x5 cell table. ID0 at the minimum-key corner is marked one fixed source/canary after actual fresh fluid observer initialization. It is a prescribed source, not a fitted impermeable physical wall. Remaining80 actual fluid targets must include both real FS and inner classifications for EVERY field.
scope: One current component runs legacy u-pw once, filterOFF once, then p=p0, constant excess16, mixedJ freeOFF, mixedJ freeON. Six81-slot CSV blocks, no physical steps. Optional --legacy runs only the same legacy block, allowing the identical main to link a retained compatible85-object closure with its matching archived headers. Do not run old dynamic feedback expecting the new cache/filter behavior.
fields: p0=62.5*(2-z) is exactly binary32 on this grid, corresponding to rhow1000 and prescribed g_z=-1/16; no gravity evolution is called. J=.75/1/1.25 by original ID modulo3, with the matching actual physical-rho binary32 cache. Mixed excess=-16/0/+16 correlates with J. All pressure/sigma/kappa/state arrays are initialized. No material return or hydrostatic initializer is exercised.
reference: Independent all-slot support scan includes self exactly once, all admissible fluid and the one fixed source. Same production float rr2/inclusive kernel cutoff and actual float Cubic kernel values are intentionally used; volume is independently Mass/RhopZero*J, including self and the fixed source. It does not call the production neighbor walker, porosity state helper or filter. An independently assembled literal old float Mass/Rhop weight reference must differ resolvably on at least one mixed-J target, without an arbitrary physical-amplitude threshold.
roundoff_budget: Only output binary32 half-ULP plus a forward-error envelope gamma_(8N+32) for independent binary64 weighted-sum/division/readdition order. Same exact float kernel inputs; no continuum/kernel-accuracy claim. The zero and exact-power-of-two constant excess fields additionally require all160 fluid outputs to retain their original pressure bits.
projection: In the freeON mixed-J case, actual ApplyPorePressureBoundaries first computes the real mask and projects initial positive surface p. Actual ShepardRegularizePorePressure then filters and applies the new local saved-mask positive clamp. At least one independent unprojected postfilter surface result must be positive and actual result exact+0. Finite negative/zero final surface p are allowed; smoothing may change them. Existing rates, baseline, geometry, J/theta, sigma, kappa, velocity/cache, IDs/code/cell arrays, FS mask/normals/divergence/correction matrix and load arrays are byte-preserved. The fixed source p is unchanged. There is no second wall fit or FS pass inside the new filter wrapper.
default_compatibility: filterOFF checks every captured state array including p byte-for-byte. Legacy u-pw selects DynamicPorePressure=false/PorosityFeedback=false/freeOFF and calls the real production filter with nonuniform fields and the old Mass/Rhop path. rows.csv and legacy.csv contain actual float bits; root can compare legacy.csv from new full component against retained-object --legacy output without normalizing data. No new historical comparison pass is claimed before actual execution.
CLI: [--legacy] --out FRESH_DIR; refuse existing result directory; failures preserve partial outputs and have no retry.
limits: Cubic2D only. A field-only observer component does not prove public container admission, actual interval40 scheduling, damping, actual pre/corrector ordering, wall-state freshness, prestress equilibrium or coupled physical accuracy. No dummy stage pointer is used. No new half/control/long solver chain, pressure fit or physical tolerance.
